archive_on_destroy.description: Archive the repository instead of deleting it on destroy. Default: false.

template.description: Create the repository from a template repository.

include_all_branches.description: Copy all branches of the template, not only the default branch.

allow_update_branch.description: Always suggest to update pull request branches.

team_access.description: Team permissions. The most specific tier that sets this list replaces the inherited one.

permission.description: One of: pull, triage, push, maintain, admin.

user_access.description: Collaborator permissions. The most specific tier that sets this list replaces the inherited one.

permission.description: One of: pull, triage, push, maintain, admin.

labels.description: Issue labels. The most specific tier that sets this list replaces the inherited one. Labels not in the final list are deleted.

color.description: Label color as a hex code without the leading #.

branch_rulesets.description: Repository rulesets keyed by ruleset name. The tiers are merged field by field.

target.description: Ruleset target: branch, tag or push. Default: branch.

enforcement.description: Enforcement: active, evaluate or disabled. Default: active.

bypass_actors.description: Actors that can bypass the ruleset. The most specific tier that sets this list replaces the inherited one.

actor_id.description: Actor ID (team, integration or role ID).

actor_type.description: One of: RepositoryRole, Team, Integration, OrganizationAdmin, DeployKey.

extra_bypass_actors.description: Bypass actors added to `bypass_actors` from every tier.

actor_id.description: Actor ID (team, integration or role ID).

actor_type.description: One of: RepositoryRole, Team, Integration, OrganizationAdmin, DeployKey.

include.description: Ref patterns to include, added from every tier. Short names like main become refs/heads/main.

exclude.description: Ref patterns to exclude, added from every tier.

rules.description: Ruleset rules. Each scalar comes from the most specific tier that sets it.

creation.description: Only allow users with bypass permission to create matching refs.

deletion.description: Only allow users with bypass permission to delete matching refs.

update.description: Only allow users with bypass permission to update matching refs.

pull_request.description: Require a pull request before merging.

allowed_merge_methods.description: Allowed merge methods: merge, squash, rebase.

dismiss_stale_reviews_on_push.description: Dismiss approvals when new commits are pushed.

require_last_push_approval.description: Require approval of the most recent push by someone else.

require_code_owner_review.description: Require a review from code owners.

required_review_thread_resolution.description: Require all review threads to be resolved.

required_status_checks.description: Require status checks to pass before merging.

strict_required_status_checks_policy.description: Require branches to be up to date before merging.

do_not_enforce_on_create.description: Do not enforce the checks when a branch is created.

required_check.description: Required checks, added from every tier.

integration_id.description: ID of the GitHub App that must report the check.

required_code_scanning.description: Require code scanning results. Tools are merged by name across tiers.

tool.description: Name of the code scanning tool.

alerts_threshold.description: Alert severity that blocks the merge. Default: none.

security_alerts_threshold.description: Security alert severity that blocks the merge. Default: none.

merge_queue.description: Merge queue settings. The most specific tier that sets this object replaces the inherited one.

merge_method.description: MERGE, SQUASH or REBASE. Default: MERGE.

check_response_timeout_minutes.description: Minutes to wait for checks. Default: 60.

min_entries_to_merge.description: Minimum entries in a merge group. Default: 1.

max_entries_to_merge.description: Maximum entries in a merge group. Default: 5.

min_entries_to_merge_wait_minutes.description: Minutes to wait for the minimum group size. Default: 5.

max_entries_to_build.description: Maximum entries to build at the same time. Default: 5.

copilot_code_review.description: Request a Copilot code review on pull requests.
